Results-driven Engineering Lead with 8+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable, secure, and cloud-native backend systems. Specialized in the Spring ecosystem including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, OAuth2, and AOP, with hands-on expertise in Java 8/11/17 and microservices architecture. Passionate about performance optimization, cost-effective cloud deployment, and team mentorship.

PROFILE SUMMARY
Results-driven Engineering Lead with 8+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable, secure, and cloud-native backend systems. Specialized in the Spring ecosystem including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, OAuth2, and AOP, with hands-on expertise in Java 8/11/17 and microservices architecture. Adept at leading teams, architecting resilient APIs, implementing API gateways, and deploying services using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as AWS and DigitalOcean. Passionate about performance optimization, cost-effective cloud deployment, and team mentorship.

SKILLS
Programming Languages: Java 8, SQL, HTML, CSS, Python, TypeScript
Frameworks: Spring, Spring Boot, Angular 4+, Django, Express Js, Node js

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
NIQ	PUNE, INDIA
Senior Software Engineer	Oct 2024 to June 2025
Route to Market - Precision Area (Oct 2024 - June 2025)
Skills - Rest Microservices, System Design, SQL, MySQL, JAVA 8, Spring Boot Framework, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, AWS - ECS, RDS, Redis Cache, Docker, Agile, Scrum, JIRA, GIT, Confluence, Sonar Qube, Datadog, CI-CD Pipelines, Snowflake, Angular
RTM-PA was a project to provide insights of FMCG product performance against the market, UI was in Angular and Micro Services was in Java - Spring Boot.
As senior engineer was responsible for supporting production issues as well as was responsible for leading a team of 4.
Majorly handled backend APIs for example User Preferences APIs, I handled datadog logging systems and dashboards.
Handled releases without any hiccups.
Got a chance to work on Angular UI.
DASSAULT SYSTÈMES	PUNE, INDIA
Research and Development Engineer	Oct 2020 to Sept 2024
Master Data Management (Jan 2023 - Sept 2024)
Skills - Rest Microservices, System Design, SQL, PostgreSQL, Java 8, Spring Boot Framework, Multithreading, AWS - ECS, RDS, Redis Cache, Docker,Team Management, Project Management, Agile, Scrum, JIRA, GIT, Confluence, Sonar Qube, Sumo-Logic, CI-CD Pipelines
Worked as R&D Engineer for Master Data Management Project. Its project to curate all data related clinical trials present under the sun. It was a huge data collection project.
Managed team of 4 and project. Helped the team to improve scrum procedures, release procedures, and smoothing overall process.
Expanded Data model to accept all kinds of data related to study (clinical trial)
Migrated project to AWS ECS and implemented CI-CD pipeline which enhanced deployment procedure. Optimised use of RDS instances. These activities lead to reduced cost by almost 50%.
Worked on system redesign for the application.
Site Payment Analytics (Aug 2022 – Jan 2024)
Skills - Data Analysis, EDA, Machine Learning, SQL, MySQL, Python, AWS – EC2,
RDS, Agile, Scrum, JIRA, GIT, Confluence
Worked as Data Analyst for Site Payment Analytics Project. Its efforts to figure out the drug trial expenditure trends, in pre-covid, in-covid and post-covid world.
Clinical Trial Management System(Oct 2020 – Dec 2023)
Skills - Java 8, Monolithic, Multithreading, System Design, SQL, MySQL, AWS –
EC2, RDS, Redis Cache, Agile, Scrum, JIRA, GIT, Confluence, MQ
Worked as R&D Engineer for Clinical Trial Management System. Its legacy JAVA project has been running for the last 16 years. I actively worked to enhance and support production issues.
Enhanced performance of the application via query improvement and threading.
Enhanced database sync utility which avoided escalations from major customers.
Working on many features and issues to enhance legacy projects.
Coordinated major releases without an issue.
INFOCEPTS TECHNOLOGIES PVT. LTD.	NAGPUR, INDIA
Senior Executive	Jan 2017 to Oct 2020
Worked on 2 long term cross vendor projects - NIS-Rewrite and Connect DCM as Full Stack developer. Few Highlights :
Skills - Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, OAuth2.0 Microservices, Multithreading, System Design, SQL, MySQL, AWS – EC2, RDS, Redis Cache, Angular 8, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Team Management, Project Management, Agile, Scrum, JIRA, GIT, Confluence
Projects were for managing MicroStrategy users and their projects. We had integrated common SSO via Spring Security and personalized user checks which we had to verify via MicroStrategy server to validate users and manage their project/ create project from project using APIs.
Worked extensively on microservices - 7 microservice projects having approx. 10 APIs each.
Worked on Angular 8 for frontend to create forms, API Integrations and data flow on UI. Reduced overhead on UI by caching.
Led team of 4 for 1 year as offshore technical lead.
Pulled more billable work for the company and onboarded 2 additional billable resources.
Moved these legacy projects from SVN to GIT. Implemented git branching model.
Actively worked for COE to help other Developers as well as Sales Team to pitch the work.
International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore	May 2019 to May 2020 Academic Projects – Classification of fraudulent credit card transactions, Telecom Churn Case Study
BE – COMPUTER TECHNOLOGY	NAGPUR, INDIA
Yeshwantrao Chavan College of Engineering, Nagpur	Aug 2012 to May 2016
PRO-BONO CONSUTLANCY
To keep in touch with frontend technologies I was helping with some projects as a pro bono activity. The team used to connect me twice a week with their queries and issues for guidance and directions. It helped me to be updated with technology. Some of my work are as below -
FLYMEOUT INC.	Remote (North Carolina, USA)
Tech - Consultant	May 2023 to August 2025
Skills - Rest Microservices, System Design, SQL, MySQL, AWS – EC2, RDS, Redis Cache, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Team Management, Project Management, Agile, Scrum, JIRA, GIT
Guided team to build product https://flymeout.io and iOS Application and led them to successful launch of product.
Helped the team to achieve their funding of over million dollars and monthly revenue over 30 thousand dollars during financial years 2023-24 and 2024-25
Guided them for backend architecture, database structure so that they can scale at a high extent. Now team is just plugging different modules to move ahead
Guided them with frontend structure and helped to take decisions.
Guided the team to start their scrum team.
Helped team to establish CI-CD pipelines via github and digital ocean
LittlePlanet Studio	Remote (New York, USA)
Tech - Consultant	Aug 2020 to May 2023
Skills - Rest Microservices, System Design, SQL, MySQL, AWS – EC2, RDS, Redis Cache, Angular 8, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Team Management, Project Management, Agile, Scrum, JIRA, GIT
Guided the team to start their studio – LittlePlanet Studio and led them to generate USD 100K Revenue in the financial year 2020-21. Guided them for many of their projects of tech stack Angular 8, HTML, CSS, JS.
Guided the team to create product usepromo.io. It includes end-user and admin frontend in Angular 8, APIs in NodeJS, MySQL as database and AWS as hosting server for application and database.
Guided the team for marketing as well as sales strategy.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Won a hackathon in Medidata and got a chance to present an idea to the Global CTO of Dassault Group.
Learned Python from scratch and started on it as a backend developer.
Currently practicing AI-ML and preparing to dive into the Data Science domain.
Got nomination for Talent of the Year during InfoCepts’ annual recognition for 2018
Got awarded the title of being in the “Top Contributor” by the InfoCepts’ App Dev COE 2019.
Worked with InfoCepts’ ICare NGO and also took part in La Foundation of Dassault.
